summary_en: This Phase II trial tests belzutifan alone, pembrolizumab alone, or the two drugs together, given before a partial or total nephrectomy, in locally advanced clear cell renal cell carcinoma. Both drugs are listed as oral medicines, and the record lists evaluations at baseline and at 3, 6, 9, and 12 weeks after treatment starts, but how long or how often the drugs are taken is not stated. The main outcome the study measures is not stated; the trial is Phase II.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase II evalúa belzutifan solo, pembrolizumab solo, o ambos medicamentos juntos, administrados antes de una nefrectomía parcial o total, en el carcinoma de células renales de células claras localmente avanzado. Ambos medicamentos figuran como de administración oral, y el registro indica evaluaciones al inicio y a las 3, 6, 9 y 12 semanas después de comenzar el tratamiento, pero no se indica por cuánto tiempo ni con qué frecuencia se toman los medicamentos. El resultado principal que mide el estudio no se indica; el ensayo es de fase II.
who_for: Biopsy or archival tissue confirms clear cell renal cell carcinoma
Intermediate-high risk, high risk, or M1 disease by the stated tumor, node, metastasis, and grade criteria
Evaluated by urology and approved as a candidate for nephrectomy
Age 18 or older and able to give written consent
No distant metastases on chest, abdomen, and pelvis imaging within 42 days of enrollment
not_for: Prior chemotherapy or radiotherapy for kidney cancer
Prior anti-PD-1, PD-L1, PD-L2, or CTLA-4 therapy
Prior treatment with belzutifan or another HIF-2 alpha inhibitor
Another cancer that is progressing or needed active treatment within the past 3 years
